Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure is a single pressure-temperature plot headed H2O. The vertical axis reads "Pressure, p (atm)" with ticks at 0.006, 1, and 218, and the horizontal axis reads "Temperature, T (C)" with ticks at 0, 0.01, 100, and 374, the spacing on both visibly nonlinear. Two red curves meet at a filled dot labeled "Triple point" at 0.006 atm and 0.01 degrees, with dashed guide lines running to both axes. From that dot one branch rises almost vertically and leans slightly left, while the other sweeps up and to the right, ending at a second filled dot labeled "Critical point" at 218 atm and 374 degrees; below the triple point a single curve continues toward the lower left. Italic letters mark the regions the curves carve out: s at the left, l in the wedge between the branches, and v at the right. Curved arrows tag the branches "Melting", "Boiling", and "Sublimation", and a dashed pair marks the crossing at 1 atm and 100 degrees. Locating a point against these curves tells the reader which phase water occupies there. The plot lays out the coexistence boundaries, including the leftward-leaning melting line whose negative slope means added pressure can melt ice.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Slider for temperature and pressure: the learner adjusts T and p controls, a state point moves across the diagram and the solid, liquid, or vapor region highlights, making clear that phase is determined by location relative to the coexistence curves.
- Slider for pressure near the melting boundary: the learner raises pressure along a fixed-temperature line close to 0 degrees C, the state point crosses the left-leaning melting curve and the phase label changes from solid to liquid, making clear why added pressure can melt ice.
- Toggle between heating paths: the learner switches among a 1 atm path, a low-pressure path through the triple point area, and a supercritical path, the crossed boundaries and transition labels appear, making clear how boiling, sublimation, and the critical point depend on the path through p-T space.

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax University Physics, chapter 18: Temperature and Heat

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

(function () { var draw = SVG().addTo(document.getElementById('container')).size('100%', '100%'); var frame = setPlotFrame({ xDomain: [0, 1], yDomain: [0, 1], margin: 56, draw: draw }); // ---- schematic normalized maps (nx,ny in [0,1]) ---- var T_ANCH = [[0.13, 0], [0.18, 0.01], [0.627, 100], [0.82, 374]]; function tOfNx(nx) { if (nx <= T_ANCH[0][0]) return (nx - T_ANCH[0][0]) * (0.01 / 0.05); for (var i = 0; i < T_ANCH.length - 1; i++) { if (nx <= T_ANCH[i + 1][0]) { var a = T_ANCH[i], b = T_ANCH[i + 1]; return a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * (nx - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0]); } } return 374; } // pressure anchors in (ny, log10 p) function pOfNy(ny) { var lp; if (ny <= 0.48) lp = -2.222 + (0 - -2.222) / (0.48 - 0.30) * (ny - 0.30); else lp = 0 + (2.338 - 0) / (0.91 - 0.48) * (ny - 0.48); return Math.pow(10, lp); } // ---- coexistence boundaries in normalized space ---- function nxMelt(ny) { return 0.18 - 0.0846 * (ny - 0.30); } // leans left function nyVap(nx) { return 2.848 * nx * nx - 1.894 * nx + 0.5486; } function nySub(nx) { return 0.02 + 2.154 * (nx - 0.05); } var TP = [0.18, 0.30], CP = [0.82, 0.91]; function phaseOf(nx, ny) { if (nx < nxMelt(ny) && ny > nySub(Math.max(nx, 0.05))) return 'solid'; if (ny > nyVap(nx) && nx >= nxMelt(ny)) return 'liquid'; return 'vapor'; } var PHASE_COLOR = { solid: '#9ecae1', liquid: '#6baed6', vapor: '#fcae91' }; var PHASE_TXT = { solid: '#08519c', liquid: '#08306b', vapor: '#a63603' }; function sample(fn, a, b, n, asX) { var pts = []; for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) { var t = a + (b - a) * i / n; var nx = asX ? t : fn(t), ny = asX ? fn(t) : t; pts.push([plotX(nx), plotY(ny)]); } return pts; } function ptsAttr(p) { return p.map(function (q) { return q[0] + ',' + q[1]; }).join(' '); } // ---- region polygons ---- function meltingPts() { return sample(function (ny) { return nxMelt(ny); }, 0.95, 0.30, 30, false); } function vapPts() { return sample(nyVap, 0.18, 0.82, 40, true); } function subPts() { return sample(nySub, 0.18, 0.10, 20, true); } var solidPoly = [[plotX(0.10), plotY(0.95)]].concat(meltingPts(), subPts(), [[plotX(0.10), plotY(0.128)]]); var liquidPoly = meltingPts().slice().reverse().concat([[plotX(0.125), plotY(0.95)], [plotX(0.82), plotY(0.95)], [plotX(0.82), plotY(0.91)]], vapPts().slice().reverse()); var vaporPoly = vapPts().concat([[plotX(0.95), plotY(0.91)], [plotX(0.95), plotY(0.02)], [plotX(0.10), plotY(0.02)], [plotX(0.10), plotY(0.128)]], subPts().slice().reverse()); var regionEls = { solid: draw.polygon(ptsAttr(solidPoly)).fill({ color: PHASE_COLOR.solid, opacity: 0 }), liquid: draw.polygon(ptsAttr(liquidPoly)).fill({ color: PHASE_COLOR.liquid, opacity: 0 }), vapor: draw.polygon(ptsAttr(vaporPoly)).fill({ color: PHASE_COLOR.vapor, opacity: 0 }) }; regionEls.solid.stroke('none'); regionEls.liquid.stroke('none'); regionEls.vapor.stroke('none'); // ---- axes ---- var axCol = '#222'; draw.line(plotX(0.10), plotY(0.02), plotX(0.10), plotY(0.97)).stroke({ color: axCol, width: 1.4 }); draw.polygon((plotX(0.10) - 4) + ',' + plotY(0.955) + ' ' + (plotX(0.10) + 4) + ',' + plotY(0.955) + ' ' + plotX(0.10) + ',' + plotY(0.985)).fill(axCol); draw.line(plotX(0.10), plotY(0.02), plotX(0.97), plotY(0.02)).stroke({ color: axCol, width: 1.4 }); draw.polygon((plotX(0.955)) + ',' + (plotY(0.02) - 4) + ' ' + (plotX(0.955)) + ',' + (plotY(0.02) + 4) + ' ' + plotX(0.985) + ',' + plotY(0.02)).fill(axCol); function tick(nx, ny, txt, side) { if (side === 'x') { draw.line(plotX(nx), plotY(0.02), plotX(nx), plotY(0.02) + 5).stroke({ color: axCol, width: 1 }); draw.text(txt).attr({ 'font-size': 11, 'text-anchor': 'middle', x: plotX(nx), y: plotY(0.02) + 8, fill: '#222' }); } else { draw.line(plotX(0.10) - 5, plotY(ny), plotX(0.10), plotY(ny)).stroke({ color: axCol, width: 1 }); draw.text(txt).attr({ 'font-size': 11, 'text-anchor': 'end', x: plotX(0.10) - 8, y: plotY(ny) + 4, fill: '#222' }); } } [0.13, 0.18, 0.627, 0.82].forEach(function (nx, i) { tick(nx, 0, ['0', '0.01', '100', '374'][i], 'x'); }); [0.30, 0.48, 0.91].forEach(function (ny, i) { tick(0, ny, ['0.006', '1', '218'][i], 'y'); }); draw.text('Temperature, T (°C)').attr({ 'font-size': 13, 'font-weight': 'bold', 'text-anchor': 'middle', x: plotX(0.53), y: plotY(0.02) + 30, fill: '#111' }); draw.text('Pressure, p (atm)').attr({ 'font-size': 13, 'font-weight': 'bold', 'text-anchor': 'middle', fill: '#111' }) .transform({ rotate: -90, cx: plotX(0.02), cy: plotY(0.5) }).attr({ x: plotX(0.02), y: plotY(0.5) }); draw.text('H').attr({ 'font-size': 18, 'font-weight': 'bold', x: plotX(0.50), y: 6, fill: '#111' }); draw.text('2').attr({ 'font-size': 12, 'font-weight': 'bold', x: plotX(0.50) + 14, y: 12, fill: '#111' }); draw.text('O').attr({ 'font-size': 18, 'font-weight': 'bold', x: plotX(0.50) + 22, y: 6, fill: '#111' }); // ---- dashed guide lines ---- function dash(x1, y1, x2, y2) { draw.line(plotX(x1), plotY(y1), plotX(x2), plotY(y2)).stroke({ color: '#888', width: 1, dasharray: '5,4' }); } dash(TP[0], 0.02, TP[0], TP[1]); dash(0.10, TP[1], TP[0], TP[1]); dash(CP[0], 0.02, CP[0], CP[1]); dash(0.10, CP[1], CP[0], CP[1]); dash(0.627, 0.02, 0.627, 0.48); dash(0.10, 0.48, 0.627, 0.48); // ---- coexistence curves (red) ---- var red = '#d62728'; function curve(pts) { return draw.polyline(ptsAttr(pts)).fill('none').stroke({ color: red, width: 2, linecap: 'round', linejoin: 'round' }); } var meltCurve = curve(meltingPts()); var vapCurve = curve(vapPts()); var subCurve = curve(subPts().concat([[plotX(0.06), plotY(0.04)]])); meltCurve.css('cursor', 'pointer').on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Melting curve: solid ⇄ liquid. Negative slope → pressure melts ice.', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); vapCurve.css('cursor', 'pointer').on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Vaporization curve: liquid ⇄ vapor. Ends at the critical point.', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); subCurve.css('cursor', 'pointer').on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Sublimation curve: solid ⇄ vapor (below the triple point).', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); // ---- region letters ---- function rlabel(nx, ny, t) { draw.text(t).attr({ 'font-size': 15, 'font-style': 'italic', 'text-anchor': 'middle', x: plotX(nx), y: plotY(ny), fill: '#333', 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 3 }); } rlabel(0.135, 0.46, 's'); rlabel(0.40, 0.62, 'l'); rlabel(0.70, 0.40, 'v'); // ---- curved arrows + tags ---- function arrow(x1, y1, cx, cy, x2, y2) { draw.path('M' + plotX(x1) + ' ' + plotY(y1) + ' Q' + plotX(cx) + ' ' + plotY(cy) + ' ' + plotX(x2) + ' ' + plotY(y2)) .fill('none').stroke({ color: '#111', width: 1.4 }); var ang = Math.atan2(plotY(y2) - plotY(cy), plotX(x2) - plotX(cx)); var a1 = ang + 2.6, a2 = ang - 2.6, L = 7; draw.polygon([ [plotX(x2), plotY(y2)], [plotX(x2) + L * Math.cos(a1), plotY(y2) + L * Math.sin(a1)], [plotX(x2) + L * Math.cos(a2), plotY(y2) + L * Math.sin(a2)] ].map(function (p) { return p[0] + ',' + p[1]; }).join(' ')).fill('#111'); } function tag(nx, ny, t, anchor) { draw.text(t).attr({ 'font-size': 12, 'text-anchor': anchor || 'start', x: plotX(nx), y: plotY(ny), fill: '#111' }); } arrow(0.05, 0.78, 0.10, 0.74, 0.155, 0.72); tag(0.0, 0.80, 'Melting'); arrow(0.95, 0.62, 0.86, 0.60, 0.74, 0.62); tag(0.90, 0.60, 'Boiling', 'start'); arrow(0.05, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.13, 0.13); tag(0.0, 0.08, 'Sublimation'); // ---- triple & critical points ---- function dot(nx, ny) { return draw.circle(7).attr({ cx: plotX(nx), cy: plotY(ny), fill: '#111' }).css('cursor', 'pointer'); } var tpDot = dot(TP[0], TP[1]); tpDot.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Triple point: 0.01 °C, 0.006 atm — all three phases coexist.', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip) .on('click', function () { showPopup('Triple point', 'At 0.01 °C and 0.006 atm, solid, liquid and vapor coexist in equilibrium. It is the unique junction of the three coexistence curves.'); }); var cpDot = dot(CP[0], CP[1]); cpDot.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('Critical point: 374 °C, 218 atm — liquid/vapor distinction vanishes.', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip) .on('click', function () { showPopup('Critical point', 'Above 374 °C and 218 atm the meniscus disappears and water becomes a supercritical fluid; there is no sharp boiling transition.'); }); tag(0.20, 0.27, 'Triple', 'start'); tag(0.20, 0.235, 'point', 'start'); tag(0.74, 0.95, 'Critical point', 'start'); // ---- heating-path overlay ---- var pathGroup = draw.group(); function update_path(mode) { pathGroup.clear(); var ny = mode === '1atm' ? 0.48 : mode === 'low' ? 0.20 : 0.95; pathGroup.line(plotX(0.10), plotY(ny), plotX(0.95), plotY(ny)).stroke({ color: '#2ca02c', width: 2, dasharray: '2,3' }); var crossings = []; if (ny >= 0.30) { var mx = nxMelt(ny); if (mx > 0.10 && mx < 0.82) crossings.push([mx, 'melting']); } else { var sx = 0.05 + (ny - 0.02) / 2.154; if (sx > 0.10 && sx < 0.18) crossings.push([sx, 'sublimation']); } var A = 2.848, B = -1.894, C = 0.5486 - ny, D = B * B - 4 * A * C; if (D >= 0) { var r = (-B + Math.sqrt(D)) / (2 * A); if (r > 0.18 && r < 0.82) crossings.push([r, 'boiling']); } crossings.sort(function (a, b) { return a[0] - b[0]; }); crossings.forEach(function (c) { pathGroup.circle(8).attr({ cx: plotX(c[0]), cy: plotY(ny), fill: '#fff', stroke: '#2ca02c', 'stroke-width': 2 }); pathGroup.text(c[1]).attr({ 'font-size': 10, 'font-weight': 'bold', fill: '#1b7a1b', 'text-anchor': 'middle', x: plotX(c[0]), y: plotY(ny) - 8, 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 3 }); }); var note = mode === 'super' ? 'supercritical: no boundary' : (crossings.map(function (c) { return c[1]; }).join(' → ') || 'no boundary'); pathGroup.text(note).attr({ 'font-size': 10, fill: '#1b7a1b', x: plotX(0.62), y: plotY(ny) + 16, 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 3 }); } // ---- state markers ---- var stateDot = draw.circle(11).attr({ fill: '#ff7f0e', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 1.5 }).css('cursor', 'pointer'); var stateLbl = draw.text('').attr({ 'font-size': 12, 'font-weight': 'bold', 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 3 }); var meltDot = draw.circle(9).attr({ fill: '#9467bd', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 1.5 }); function highlight(phase) { ['solid', 'liquid', 'vapor'].forEach(function (k) { regionEls[k].fill({ color: PHASE_COLOR[k], opacity: k === phase ? 0.45 : 0 }); }); } window.tOfNx = tOfNx; window.pOfNy = pOfNy; window.update_state = function () { var nx = +document.getElementById('tempInput').value; var ny = +document.getElementById('presInput').value; var ph = phaseOf(nx, ny); highlight(ph); stateDot.attr({ cx: plotX(nx), cy: plotY(ny) }); stateLbl.attr({ x: plotX(nx) + 9, y: plotY(ny) - 8, fill: PHASE_TXT[ph] }).text(ph); stateDot.on('mousemove', function (e) { showTooltip('T=' + Math.round(tOfNx(nx)) + ' °C, p=' + pOfNy(ny).toPrecision(2) + ' atm → ' + ph, e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); }; window.update_melt = function () { var ny = +document.getElementById('meltInput').value; var nx = 0.13; // T = 0 °C var ph = phaseOf(nx, ny); document.getElementById('meltVal').value = pOfNy(ny).toPrecision(2); var mp = document.getElementById('meltPhase'); mp.value = ph; mp.style.color = PHASE_TXT[ph]; meltDot.attr({ cx: plotX(nx), cy: plotY(ny), fill: PHASE_COLOR[ph], stroke: '#5b2d86' }); }; window.update_path = update_path; // ---- demo steps ---- var steps = [ { t: 0.40, p: 0.48, m: 0.20, path: '1atm', txt: 'Move the state point with T and p; the highlighted region shows water\'s phase.' }, { t: 0.13, p: 0.20, m: 0.20, path: '1atm', txt: 'At T=0 °C and low pressure the point sits in the SOLID region (left of the melting line).' }, { t: 0.13, p: 0.90, m: 0.90, path: '1atm', txt: 'Raise pressure at T=0 °C: the point crosses the left-leaning melting curve into LIQUID — pressure melts ice.' }, { t: 0.40, p: 0.48, m: 0.20, path: 'low', txt: 'A low-pressure heating path crosses only the sublimation curve: solid → vapor, no liquid.' } ]; var cur = 0; function applyStep(i) { cur = i; var s = steps[i]; document.getElementById('tempInput').value = s.t; document.getElementById('tempVal').value = Math.round(tOfNx(s.t)); document.getElementById('presInput').value = s.p; document.getElementById('presVal').value = pOfNy(s.p).toPrecision(2); document.getElementById('meltInput').value = s.m; document.getElementById('pathInput').value = s.path; document.getElementById('demoNarration').textContent = s.txt; document.getElementById('stepLabel').textContent = i + '/' + (steps.length - 1); update_state(); update_melt(); update_path(s.path); } window.nextStep = function () { applyStep(Math.min(cur + 1, steps.length - 1)); }; window.prevStep = function () { applyStep(Math.max(cur - 1, 0)); }; applyStep(0); window.__markRendered(); })(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
